definitions.gloss: profile; bio (casual abbreviation of プロフィール)
definitions.explanation: A clipped, colloquial form of プロフィール (profile), referring to a self-introduction page or bio on a social-media or messaging app.

examples.japanese: プロフに{趣味|しゅみ}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote my hobbies in my profile.

examples.japanese: {気|き}になる{人|ひと}のプロフをこっそり{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I secretly checked the profile of someone I was interested in.

notes:
A casual clipping of プロフィール (profile). Common among younger users on social media and messaging apps.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プロフを{書|か}く: to write one's profile
- プロフ{画像|がぞう}: profile picture
- プロフを{更新|こうしん}する: to update one's profile
